intended_job: Diagnose a software defect or incident from supplied evidence without collapsing observations, hypotheses, mitigation, and confirmed cause into the same claim.

historical_pre_runtime_issues.summary: The earlier finished Free prompt exposed only DIAGNOSE_FIRST, MITIGATE_NOW, and FIX_SUPPORTED and did not formalize a separate input-state vocabulary.
historical_pre_runtime_issues.resolution: Starter adopted INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and CAUSE_CONFIRMED plus DIAGNOSABLE input states so missing evidence and confirmed cause remain explicit rather than compressed.
